# Citations

All sources visited in-session (WebSearch and/or WebFetch) during research on
2026-06-02. Each entry has a stable anchor (`#cN`) so in-text markdown links
(`[[N]](citations.md#cN)`) survive conversion to other formats.

**Access note convention:** Several large domains (Canon official spec pages,
B&H, Amateur Photographer, The Digital Picture, Canon Rumors, Manfrotto)
returned HTTP 403/anti-bot blocks to direct WebFetch. Where a figure came only
from a search-result snippet rather than a directly-fetched page body, the entry
is marked **Access: snippet** and was corroborated against at least one other
source. Tiers: 1 = peer/institutional, 2 = manufacturer/established reference,
3 = industry blog/practitioner, 4 = forum/social.
